register_item_in_registry: register a config object or value under a dot-separated key path in the MMF registry
get_item_from_registry: get a registered item by its dot-separated key name from the MMF registry with an optional default
register_model_class: register a model class inheriting BaseModel with a unique name using the registry decorator
register_dataset_builder: register a dataset builder class inheriting BaseDatasetBuilder with a unique name using the registry decorator
unregister_item_from_registry: unregister and remove an item from the MMF registry state by its key name
